summary: Frontend-only iteration 19 completed on public preview URL using isolated disposable fixtures. Admin candidate normal login -> in-session DB fixture remap -> admin access polling -> admin preview/publish/payout succeeded. Student login then completed search/follow/preview/progress flow successfully. All iter19 fixtures were cleaned and temporary credentials removed from active memory entries.
action_items: Optional hardening: hidden retained screens can produce duplicate testID matches in web automation; keep :visible selectors in regression scripts.
Optional cleanup note: console still shows non-blocking RN-web deprecation warnings (pointerEvents/shadow*).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth injection after mount is correctly non-deterministic due cachedToken/AuthProvider hydration; normal sign-in + in-session fixture mutation path worked as intended.
Shop admin gating logic behaved correctly with DB-verified identity/session checks and 8s polling (no page reload required).
Student guard for locked lessons held: locked lesson open action absent, preview progress persisted to My Courses.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested admin+student course flow in this iteration

seed_data_creation: Created isolated disposable iter19 fixtures (admin candidate, creator, student, pending course with preview+locked lessons, earning 9 EUR). Removed all fixture data after execution, including course_progress by fixture course_id and credentials list cleanup markers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not reuse iter19 fixture credentials; they were deleted and cleanup markers were written in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. If repeating this path, create a fresh disposable fixture and reuse normal login + in-session DB remap strategy.
rca_of_issue: No product bug found in requested scope. Earlier automation failures were harness-related (pymongo import context, modal click viewport, hidden duplicate selectors). Once harness used venv python + visible selectors, required flow passed end-to-end.
